observations: Photo 0 shows the rear of a black DSLR camera with a large LCD screen, control buttons, and a top-mounted viewfinder. The camera appears to be in used condition with some dust and minor wear.

Photo 1 shows the front of the camera with the lens cap on, revealing the sensor area. The camera body is black with 'Nikon' and 'Z' branding visible. The top has a mode dial, shutter button, and a small LCD screen.
Photo 2 shows the top of the camera with the LCD screen turned off. The camera has a hot shoe, mode dial, and buttons labeled 'BKT', 'WB', 'MODE'. The 'Z' logo is visible on the top right.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI DANIEL OYENIYI'.

claims.evidence: Photos show visible dust and minor wear, but no functional test is shown. No proof of internal condition or lens attachment.
Photo 0 shows dust and smudges on the lens and body, especially around the viewfinder and buttons. The lens cap is on, but the lens itself is not visible.

risks.proof: Photo of the lens attached to the camera, showing condition and attachment.

risks.risk: Sensor or internal components may be damaged.

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional.

Photo of the lens attached to the camera.
Photo of the battery and charger.
Close-up of the sensor if possible.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
